entries.name: SimulateTxAccessor_v1_5_0
entries.description: Library that Safe tooling delegatecalls from an account to simulate a transaction and estimate its gas.

entries.name: SafeProxyFactory_v1_5_0
entries.description: Deploys Safe accounts as proxies and sets them up in the same transaction. It has no owner and no control over the accounts it created.

entries.name: MultiSend_v1_5_0
entries.description: Library that Safe accounts delegatecall to execute a batch of transactions, each a call or a delegatecall.

entries.name: SafeL2_v1_4_1
entries.description: Same as the v1.4.1 implementation, but it also emits an event for every executed transaction, for indexing on chains without transaction tracing.

entries.name: CreateCall_v1_5_0
entries.description: Library that Safe accounts delegatecall to deploy contracts with CREATE or CREATE2.

entries.name: GnosisSafeL2
entries.description: Same as the v1.3.0 implementation, but it also emits an event for every executed transaction, for indexing on chains without transaction tracing.

entries.name: CompatibilityFallbackHandler_v1_5_0
entries.description: Default fallback handler for Safe accounts: lets them receive ERC-721, ERC-1155 and ERC-777 tokens and answer EIP-1271 signature checks. It has no owner and no state.

entries.name: MultiSendCallOnly_v1_3_0
entries.description: Like MultiSend, but the batch can only contain regular calls.

entries.name: Safe_v1_4_1
entries.description: Implementation of Safe v1.4.1 multisig accounts, which are proxies that delegatecall it. Accounts have M-of-N owners and optional modules, guard and fallback handler. Immutable and ownerless; it locks itself at deployment.
